parameters.name: ClientIp
parameters.description: The IP address of the client.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the OceanBase cluster.

parameters.name: ServerIp
parameters.description: The IP address of the server.

parameters.name: SqlText
parameters.description: The SQL statement, which can contain LIKE clauses. You can specify only part of the clauses in the SQL statement.

parameters.name: UId
parameters.description: The user identifier (UID) of the OceanBase database.
